oimr.options.host_only_tooltip: Only the Singleplayer/LAN host or server console can change these settings.
oimr.settings.title: One Inventory, Many Regrets
oimr.settings.slots_duplication_warning: Note: Disabling slot sync drops shared items before switching to personal slots.
Turning off sync for a hotbar or equipment slot drops any currently shared item at the configuring player (or priority teammate) before unlocking per-player storage.
oimr.warning.affinity_reset: [OIMR] Invalid affinity value detected in config (> 100%% or invalid); affinity was reset to 100%%.
oimr.settings.affinity.tooltip: Controls how strongly effects, healing, knockback, damage, and Respiration are shared. At 100%%, all teammate deaths are linked; below 100%% de-syncs mandatory deaths (e.g. at 50%%, 10 damage to A deals 5 to teammates). Does not affect synced inventory slots.
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.n: Damage for 1 group heart: none (0%% affinity)
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.t: Shows how much damage one member must take (2 HP = 1 heart) for teammates to take 1 full heart (2 HP) of shared damage.
oimr.settings.hunger_weight.tooltip: Per-player hunger exhaustion multiplier: (Weight * Action) / PartySize.
oimr.settings.xp_weight.tooltip: Per-player experience gain multiplier: (Weight * XP) / PartySize. Spending XP (enchantments, anvil) remains unchanged.
oimr.settings.sync_effects.tooltip: Synchronizes status effects with duration (potions, beacons, poison, etc.) across group members. Disable for testing.
oimr.settings.sync_hotbar.tooltip: When enabled, all 9 hotbar slots (including your main hand) are shared across the group.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.tooltip: When Hotbar sync is OFF, syncs Hotbar Slot 1 as a shared main-hand slot.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.coupled_too: Controlled by Sync Hotbar while Hotbar syncing is enabled (main hand uses the selected hotbar slot).
oimr.settings.sync_off_hand.tooltip: Synchronizes the offhand slot across group members.
oimr.settings.sync_helmet.tooltip: Synchronizes the helmet armor slot across group members.
oimr.settings.sync_chestplate.tooltip: Synchronizes the chestplate armor slot across group members.
oimr.settings.sync_leggings.tooltip: Synchronizes the leggings armor slot across group members.
oimr.settings.sync_boots.tooltip: Synchronizes the boots armor slot across group members.
oimr.settings.shared_knockback.tooltip: Propagates knockback across the group (scaled by Affinity) and applies opposite recoil when slapping a teammate.
oimr.settings.friendly_pets.tooltip: Prevents owned or trusted pets of group members from attacking teammates.
oimr.settings.exclude_creative.tooltip: When enabled, teammates in Creative mode are not killed by 100%% Affinity cascade death.
oimr.settings.wipe_creative.tooltip: When Creative teammates survive cascade death, still wipe shared inventory, equipment, and XP.
oimr.settings.random_death_loot.tooltip: When enabled, dropped inventory, equipment, and XP on death fall at a random location chosen from all group members who died in the linked death instead of always at the player who caused the original death. Dropped items and XP orbs are hidden while on the death screen.
oimr.settings.comunism.tooltip: Shows a collective socialism joke message when the group dies of starvation.
oimr.settings.shared_ender_pearl.tooltip: Teleports the entire group to the landing position when any member teleports with an Ender Pearl.
oimr.settings.shared_portals.tooltip: Teleports the entire group together when any member travels through a Nether or End Portal.
oimr.settings.underwater_muffle.tooltip: Applies an aquatic muffled sound filter whenever you or a bonded teammate are underwater.
oimr.settings.shared_mob_sounds.tooltip: Replicates mob sounds heard by teammates with 1/N chance (N = group size), directional orientation toward the mob, matched distance, and volume scaled by Affinity.
